title: 第7章 夺舍之法第8章 秘密
content_zh:
柳露从盒子中捧出一本古书，翻开书页。
这本书的纸张不知道是用什么材质制作而成，每一页都是鲜艳的红色，而且散发着浓浓的血腥气。
柳露将古书递到长卿面前。
“你若认识这书中的内容，念与本座，本座重重有赏。”
长卿看向书页，第一页赫然清清楚楚的写着。
“换魂夺舍之法，此法乃是逆天邪术，邪中之邪，非极其必要切莫使用，慎之又慎，切记切记。因此法限制繁多，反噬恐怖，使用之前当熟读本书，慎之又慎，切记切记......”
“这竟然是正儿八经的汉字！甚至还是现代汉字，一笔一划非常清晰，连个繁体字都没有！”
长卿无比震惊，连着往后翻了数页。
虽然每一页上都有一些字被圈了起来，而且歪歪扭扭画了一些鬼画符似的标注，但是并不妨碍长卿读懂这本书上全部的内容。
匆匆扫过一遍，这本书上详细记载着一个名为换魂夺舍之法的邪术，包含着使用的方法，需要的材料，需要注意的各种事项，虽然内容繁杂，但是条理清晰，十分易懂。
正因如此，对于长卿这个地球人来说倒显得诡异，与其说这是出现在恐怖诡异的异界的一本术法，倒不如说像是小学门口卖的“降龙十八掌”秘籍，上面的内容太好理解了。
见长卿迅速地翻阅，表情变化不定，柳露双眼微眯。
“莫非你认识这书中的字？”
长卿并没有急着回答，而是思绪飞转，思考起眼下的情况如何让自己的利益最大化。
“这是我得天独厚的优势，管这本书是真是假，现在我是唯一认识它的人，我就有了依仗。”
“断然不能将这书中的内容完全告诉她，不然我就没有了利用的价值。”
“但这书中很多地方都被标注了，很显然她不可能对这书的内容毫无了解，我必须抛出一些半真半假的内容，才能让她信服。”
想到这里，长卿长舒一口气，合上古书，把它递还给柳露。
“回仙子，此术名为换魂夺舍之术，上面记载了这个术法的禁忌，使用此术的条件，需要用到的御灵如何炼制。”
“只是这书上的字迹非常复杂，而且语序纷杂，一时之间在下并不能全部准确翻译出来。”

柳露接过书，双眼眯起，盯着长卿的表情。
而后她突然伸出枯槁的手，如同鹰爪一般，死死钳住长卿的脖子。
“胡说八道！这书写的明明是一本疗伤之术，你吃了熊心豹子胆，竟敢诓骗本座！”
说罢，她把长卿往地上重重一摔，长卿只觉五脏六腑翻江倒海一般，一口鲜血喷出。
但他不敢怠慢，赶紧挣扎着爬起来，跪在地上。
“仙子，这书确实写的换魂夺舍之术，在下怎么敢骗仙子您啊。”
柳露看着跪在面前浑身颤抖的长卿，再度将手中的书翻开。
在每一页标注的地方仔仔细细的看了半天，她才不紧不慢道。
“你当真没有骗我？”
“没有，在下说的句句属实，没有半句谎言。”
这是试探，长卿心中很清楚。
前世他就深知这柳露疑心极重，而且性格阴晴不定，非常怪异。
她显然不知道长卿并不认识这个世界的文字，担心长卿是根据书上的标注编造书中的内容来哄骗自己。
长卿早就预想到了这一点，可惜他并不认识标注上这个世界的文字。
所以他只能故意避开书上有标注的内容来说，想不到这个柳露如此多疑，还要试探一番。
他只能继续跪在地上，装出一副非常惧怕的样子。
柳露盯着跪在地上不停颤抖的长卿，确认没什么异常之后，这才满意的点点头。
“看来你确实没有诓骗本座，起来吧，跟本座仔细说说这书中都写了什么。”
长卿站起身，咳出嗓子里的污血，擦了擦嘴角的血迹。
content_en:
Liu Lu took out an ancient book from the box and opened the pages.
I don’t know what kind of material the paper of this book is made of. Every page is bright red and exudes a strong smell of blood.
Liu Lu handed the ancient book to Chang Qing.
"If you understand the contents of this book and read it to me, I will be greatly rewarded."
Changqing looked at the pages of the book, and it was clearly written on the first page.
"The method of exchanging souls and seizing bodies. This method is against heaven and evil. It is the evil among evils. Do not use it unless it is extremely necessary. Be cautious and remember it. Therefore, the method has many restrictions and the backlash is terrifying. Before using it, you should read this book carefully, be cautious, and remember it..."
"These are actually serious Chinese characters! They are even modern Chinese characters, each stroke is very clear, and there is not even a traditional Chinese character!"
Changqing was extremely shocked and turned back several pages.
Although there are some words circled on each page, and some ghostly symbols are drawn crookedly on them, it does not prevent Changqing from understanding all the contents of this book.
After a quick scan, this book contains a detailed record of a magic called the method of exchanging souls and seizing bodies. It includes the methods of use, the materials required, and various matters that need attention. Although the content is complicated, it is clearly organized and very easy to understand.
Because of this, it seemed strange to Changqing, an earthling. Rather than saying that this was a magic book that appeared in a terrifying and strange alien world, it was more like the "Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms" secret book sold at the entrance of a primary school. The content above was easy to understand.
Seeing Changqing flipping through the pages quickly, his expression changing, Liu Lu narrowed her eyes slightly.
"Do you know the words in this book?"
Changqing did not answer in a hurry, but his thoughts were racing, thinking about how to maximize his own interests in the current situation.
"This is my unique advantage. Regardless of whether this book is true or false, now that I am the only person who knows it, I have something to rely on."
"I absolutely can't tell her everything in this book, otherwise I won't be able to use it."
"But many places in the book were marked. It was obvious that she could not have no idea of the content of the book. I had to throw out some half-truths and half-falsehoods to convince her."
Thinking of this, Chang Qing breathed a sigh of relief, closed the ancient book, and handed it back to Liu Lu.
"Back to Fairy, this technique is called the technique of exchanging souls and seizing bodies. It records the taboos of this technique, the conditions for using this technique, and how to refine the required Yuling."
"It's just that the handwriting in this book is very complicated, and the word order is complicated. I can't translate everything accurately at the moment."
Liu Lu took the book and narrowed her eyes, staring at Chang Qing's expression.
Then she suddenly stretched out her withered hands, like eagle claws, and clamped tightly on Chang Qing's neck.
"Nonsense! This book is clearly a healing book. How dare you deceive me!"
After saying that, she threw Changqing hard to the ground. Changqing felt like his internal organs were tumbling, and a mouthful of blood spurted out.
But he didn't dare to neglect, and quickly struggled to get up and kneel on the ground.
"Fairy, this book does write about the art of exchanging souls and seizing bodies. How dare I lie to you, Fairy?"
Liu Lu looked at Chang Qing, who was kneeling in front of him and was shaking all over, and opened the book in his hand again.
After reading the marked areas on each page carefully for a long time, she said calmly.
"You really didn't lie to me?"
"No, everything I said is true, not a lie."
This is a temptation, Chang Qing knows it very well.
In his previous life, he knew that Liu Lu was extremely suspicious and had a very weird personality.
She obviously didn't know that Changqing didn't know the writing of this world, and was worried that Changqing was making up the contents of the book based on the markings in the book to deceive herself.
Changqing had expected this a long time ago, but unfortunately he didn't recognize the words marking this world.
So he could only deliberately avoid those marked in the bookIn terms of content, I didn’t expect that Liu Lu was so suspicious and wanted to test it out.
He could only continue to kneel on the ground, pretending to be very scared.
Liu Lu stared at Chang Qing who was kneeling on the ground and shaking. After confirming that there was nothing abnormal, she nodded with satisfaction.
"It seems that you did not deceive me. Get up and tell me carefully what is written in this book."
Changqing stood up, coughed out the blood in his throat, and wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth.
